description: This file defines the EntityIdExists class, a validation rule used within the OrangeHRM core API to verify the existence of an entity by its ID. It utilizes traits for ORM interaction and supports options for numeric and positive ID validation.

classes.name: EntityIdExists
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether an entity with a given ID exists in the database, with options for numeric and positive ID validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with the entity name and optional validation options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates input to check if the entity exists based on the provided ID and options.
